market: Global Starch and Dextrin-Based Adhesives Market
market_definition: The starch and dextrin-based adhesives market comprises plant-derived adhesives made from native, modified or dextrinised starch. It measures sales of finished formulations for corrugated board, paper bags, tubes and remoistenable applications. BY SOURCE: Corn, Wheat, Potato, Cassava / Tapioca, Other Starch Sources. BY PRODUCT FORM: Native / Modified Starch, Dextrin, Ready-to-Use Liquid. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Corrugated Board & Cartons, Paper Bags & Tubes, Remoistenable Labels & Envelopes, Bookbinding, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Protein-based and other bio-based adhesives; starch sold as food ingredient or textile size; synthetic emulsion adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
